name: fastify-plugin-sign-in-engine

test-integration.description: Run the sign-in engine against the auth server's adapters and the migrated schema (testcontainers Postgres and Redis): a disabled user never completes a sign-in and nothing about it changes, and the per-account failure ladder holds parallel guesses, waits, its hard action, known IPs and a stopped Redis as #615 asks. Requires a running Docker daemon.
